spiritual_reading:
Two universal arcana are made manifest in the alternating presence and withdrawal of Divine wisdom in the lower degree. When wisdom first flows down and becomes perceptible in outer life, every affection in the natural mind that can be stirred is raised out of its torpor toward that illumination, and the receptacles of thought are opened to receive it. But when that illumination is withdrawn from outer perception, every state, even the lowest impulses, recedes into obscurity; the whole natural mind closes itself, and a prevailing falsity and lack of perception takes possession. Then each faculty turns inward and remains shut up within that obscurity.

Great indeed is the arcanum shown in this daily alternation: for when wisdom dawns at the beginning of a new state, the outward forms of thought are unclosed, and the whole natural person and every lesser power comes forth into action, driven to oppose and extinguish the silent establishment of saving truth in the outermost degree.

This discloses the arcanum of the primal heavenly human, because when the first Divine good engaged evil directly and went forth from a higher fullness into lower things, it poured illumination over all states that were in falsity. In that moment all falsities and evils that had been stored up in interiors surged out with their derivative abilities and organized persuasions, leaving the hidden restraints and profane deeps in which they had been held. They assaulted and tore away the outermost protective truths of a sufficient complement of operative powers that had been bound about that Divine good in the first combat.

Again, when illumination is withdrawn from the outer degree and sinks from manifest presence, and all states retreat into their interior concealments and cover themselves, this likewise relates to the arcanum of the end, because it prefigures the completion of the lower order. For when every genuine truth and good in the outer domain has at last been cleansed and delivered, the unifier of all things in ultimates—the final formed receptacle of the whole—will draw all remaining goods and truths into itself and bring itself into determinate completion. This is the final state of that order, the time when the completed receptacle is elevated into the domain of pure light. Then the opposing principle, spiritual death, is shut up in servitude within the confinement of those who denied and profaned, who loved falsity; they enter with it into that servitude, and an enduring falsity prevails over them, so that thereafter no perception of truth is granted them.

These are the two arcana that are rendered visible every day through the alternation of manifest and withdrawn illumination in the lower degree, from the one source of all light.

fills.notes: Kept as ‘outer’ (not ‘body’ alone) because the substrate is mapping the assault on the ultimate, protective covering of the Five Sons: the ultimates of the First Man’s powers that were exposed to contact and could be ‘destroyed’ in the first mixture. This corresponds to the spiritual sense ‘outermost protective truths’.

assessment: All lacunae in this excerpt are either trivial letter restorations or already tightly constrained by fixed surrounding words. The only semantically weighty bracket (‘outer’) is correspondentially determined by the doctrine of ultimates: what is attacked in the first combat is the exposed, ultimate covering of the Five Sons, matching the chapter’s inside-to-outside logic.
